title: Protein Alignment and Conservation
description: Run a bounded MAFFT protein multiple-sequence alignment and map one exact reference site into unweighted column conservation evidence.

tools.name: protein_conservation_preflight
tools.description: Validate a workspace protein FASTA, exact reference identifier, and position or substitution before a researcher-approved MAFFT run.

reference_id.description: Exact first token of the reference FASTA header.

site.description: Positive reference position or one-letter substitution such as G12C.

tools.name: protein_conservation_run
tools.description: Run and persist an approved MAFFT alignment with full alignment, conservation, site observations, report, manifest, and summary outputs.
